claims.excerpt: Selective Availability: Two Changes, Seven Years Apart
claims.label: F1
claims.sourceEvidence: The supplied material dates the two interventions to May 2000 and September 2007.
claims.synthesisStatement: “Contrast ending the use of an existing feature with specifying that a future generation would omit the feature.”
claims.narrativeStatement: The narrative describes the May 2000 operational change and the September 2007 procurement choice, but does not state the elapsed interval.
claims.explanation: The two interventions are supported; “seven years apart” is a minor compression of an interval of seven years and four months.
